warnings: ฐานรากแบบที่ 2 = the pile-footing system of plan S-01 (page 24): F1 0.60 x 0.60 on one pile, F2 0.60 x 1.30 on two piles 0.22 x 0.22 x 21.00. Not the same F1/F2 as the spread footings of S-07.

F2: the plan draws two piles (0.25 / 0.40 / 0.40 / 0.25 chain) while the section's pile callout reads 'เสาเข็มจำนวน 1 ต้น' (the leader points at one of the two piles). pile_count 2 is taken from the plan (two piles drawn, chain dimensioned to both); flagged.

F2 prints two bar directions with different sizes (short way 10-DB20, long way 4-DB16): the short-way bars are main_bar, the long-way bars additional_bars. F1 prints mat 4-DB16, vertical 6-DB16 and DB12 links.
